audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, voice or sound effects.
limitations: Procedural approximation: paint scumble is a seeded Canvas 2D stroke bitmap tiled in SVG patterns, not scanned or Krita-painted texture.
Printed-paper fragments are procedural ruled patterns; the only words are the approved copy (LE SYSTÈME). No scanned newsprint.
Facets are cached at build time from Paper.js 0.12.18 boolean operations (tools/build-geometry.cjs -> geometry.js); Paper.js is not loaded at frame time.
Still-life views (profile, top, frontal, side band) are authored 2D outlines, not measured from real objects; no 3D camera or lighting.

Typography uses OS fonts: Didot (declared via @font-face local(), falling back to Georgia/Times New Roman) and Futura (falling back to Helvetica Neue/Arial). No font files are bundled, so the exact face depends on the render host.

Scene-dependent background: a dark slate café wall #2F3833 replaces the earlier #DED5BB example swatch (palette.background_policy is scene_dependent). The wall grain uses two authored tints, #3A443E and #262D29, drawn once with a seeded Canvas 2D generator and never animated.
BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json reports 0 matched sources and no contact sheets, so no source-frame observations were applied; the original craft definition is preserved.
STYLE.json lists no tech.preview_recipes; the preview demonstrates the primary implementation (Paper.js multi-view facets, registration slide, bottle view swap, hold).
